integrity: The claim is an exact Grassmann-chart computation. The determinant identity produces ten coefficient equations; exact elimination gives a product of a smooth \(\mathbb A^2\) factor and a four-variable Artin algebra. A Gröbner basis proves Hilbert function \((1,4,3)\), length \(8\), and cubic nilpotence. The bundled verifier reconstructs these identities symbolically; no finite experiment is used as a substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: Specific to \(F_2(\mathrm{SD}^3_3)\) over an algebraically closed field of characteristic different from \(2\), and to its common-kernel component. No general formula for other bounded-rank symmetric Fano schemes is claimed. Full text of the cited nets-of-conics orbit-classification paper was not available through the current transport, so an equivalent formulation there remains a residual access risk.
title: Multiplicity-eight transverse thickening on the common-kernel Fano component
